source_text: Et dixit Deus: Congregetur aqua quae est sub caelo in congregationem unam, et appareat arida. Laboremus congregare aquam sub caelo et abicere gesta opera nostra mala, quo appareat arida. Si aquas — peccata et vitia corporis — non separaverimus, arida nostra non poterit apparere nec habere fiduciam accedendi ad lucem: Omnis qui male agit odit lucem.
pass_a_gloss: And said God: Let-be-gathered water which is under heaven into gathering one, and let-appear dry-land. Let-us-labor to-gather water under heaven and to-cast-away done works our evil, that may-appear dry-land. If waters — sins and vices of-body — not we-will-have-separated, dry-land our not will-be-able to-appear nor to-have confidence of-approaching to light: Every who badly acts hates light.
pass_b_english: [[God said: Let the water under heaven be gathered into one gathering, and let the dry land appear >> Bible:Genesis 1:9]]. Let us labor to gather the water under heaven and cast away our evil deeds, so that dry land may appear. If we do not separate those waters — the sins and vices of the body — our dry land cannot appear, nor have confidence to come to the light: [[Everyone who does evil hates the light >> Bible:John 3:20]].
